comparison.objective: Break a scored ampoule neck using a protective opener while retaining the separated cap.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization, guarded tool placement, controlled levering to break a joint, and captive-part handling.
comparison.success_condition: Confirmed neck break; cap remains fully captured; body stays upright; body and opener are returned and released without forbidden contact or escape.
comparison.reason: This record tests controlled fracture and captive retention. The candidate instead preserves all components while tuning and locking a damper and demonstrating non-bottoming impacts.
